name: nsgo
desc: A cross-platform native UI engine with a Go backend: write apps in Go with signals, memos and flexbox layout, and each platform draws with its own native views…
descFull: A cross-platform native UI engine with a Go backend: write apps in Go with signals, memos and flexbox layout, and each platform draws with its own native views — iOS and its App Clips, tvOS, watchOS, macOS, Windows, Android, Linux, the web and WeChat, QQ, Alipay and Douyin mini programs
